# Rapid Wash: full business information

> Rapid Wash is a locally owned exterior cleaning and Christmas lighting company based in Carthage, Tennessee, serving homeowners in Middle Tennessee.

Website: https://rapidwash.us/
Last updated: 2026-11-24

## Business identity

- Name: Rapid Wash
- Type: exterior cleaning company with seasonal Christmas lighting (home services)
- Based in: Carthage, Tennessee
- Service area: homeowners in Middle Tennessee, about 55 miles around Carthage. See https://rapidwash.us/service-area.html. If you are not sure whether an address is in the area, text it to (629) 301-1813.
- Ownership: locally owned
- Phone and text: (629) 301-1813
- Email: rapidwashprosbros@gmail.com
- Website: https://rapidwash.us/

## Services

Year-round exterior cleaning:

- Pressure washing (homes and businesses)
- Soft washing
- Window cleaning
- Gutter cleaning
- Driveway cleaning
- Sidewalk cleaning
- Patio cleaning
- Fence and deck cleaning
- New construction cleanup (pressure washing only)

What Rapid Wash does not do: driveway sealing, deck or fence staining or sealing, gutter guard installation, window cleaning above two stories, or construction debris removal.

Customers can build a yearly maintenance plan with an instant estimate at https://rapidwash.us/plans.html.

Seasonal:

- Christmas light installation for homes

Rapid Wash uses professional pressure washers and surface-cleaning equipment, and the right pressure and cleaning solutions for different surfaces.

## Christmas light installation

Rapid Wash installs professional Christmas lighting for homes in Middle Tennessee. The process:

1. Send us photos. Request a quote, then send photos of the sides and areas of your home you want lit. Text them to (629) 301-1813 or attach them to your quote email.
2. Get your free mockup. Rapid Wash creates a free visual mockup showing what the lighting could look like on your home.
3. Request changes. Review the mockup and say what you would like changed. Rapid Wash revises it until you are happy with the design.
4. Approve and we install. Once you approve the design, Rapid Wash schedules your job and installs your Christmas lights.

The mockup is free, and customers can request changes before anything is installed. Nothing goes up until the customer has approved the design.

## Quotes and contact

- Quotes are free. Published rates: house soft washing $0.20 per sq ft (1-story) or $0.25 per sq ft (2-story); driveways, sidewalks, patios and other concrete $0.20 per sq ft. Windows, gutters, decks, fences and new construction cleanup are quoted after seeing the property. Rapid Wash confirms the price before any work starts.
- Travel fee per visit, by straight-line distance from Carthage, TN: none within 30 miles, $25 from 30 to 45 miles, $50 from 45 to 55 miles. Farther than 55 miles: text (629) 301-1813 and ask.
- Request a quote with the step-by-step form at https://rapidwash.us/quote.html, the form at https://rapidwash.us/#quote, by text or call to (629) 301-1813, or by email to rapidwashprosbros@gmail.com.
- Christmas lighting requests can also use the lighting request form at https://rapidwash.us/lights.html.
- The website quote form opens a pre-filled email in the customer's email app; the customer presses Send to deliver it.

## Frequently asked questions

### What services does Rapid Wash offer?

Rapid Wash offers year-round exterior cleaning: pressure washing, soft washing, window cleaning, gutter cleaning, and cleaning for driveways, sidewalks, patios and fences. Pressure washing is available for homes and businesses. Rapid Wash also installs Christmas lights during the holiday season.

### Does Rapid Wash pressure wash driveways?

Yes. Rapid Wash pressure washes driveways, sidewalks and patios using professional pressure washers and surface-cleaning equipment.

### Does Rapid Wash soft wash houses?

Yes. Soft washing is one of Rapid Wash's exterior cleaning services. We use the right pressure and cleaning solutions for different surfaces. Request a free quote and tell us what you'd like cleaned.

### Does Rapid Wash clean windows and gutters?

Yes. Window cleaning and gutter cleaning are both part of Rapid Wash's exterior cleaning services.

### What areas does Rapid Wash serve?

Rapid Wash is based in Carthage, Tennessee, and serves homeowners in Middle Tennessee. If you're not sure whether you're in our area, text your address to (629) 301-1813.

### How much does Rapid Wash charge?

Quotes are free. House soft washing is $0.20 per square foot for 1-story homes and $0.25 per square foot for 2-story homes. Driveways, sidewalks, patios and other concrete are $0.20 per square foot. Windows, gutters, decks, fences and new construction cleanup are quoted after we see the property. We confirm your price before any work starts.

### Does Rapid Wash charge a travel fee?

There is no travel fee within 30 miles of Carthage, Tennessee. From 30 to 45 miles away it is $25 per visit, and from 45 to 55 miles away it is $50 per visit. If you are farther than 55 miles, text your address to (629) 301-1813 and ask.

### Does Rapid Wash serve Carthage, TN?

Yes. Rapid Wash is based in Carthage, Tennessee.

### How do I get a quote?

Quotes are free. Fill out the quote form on this page or text (629) 301-1813. For Christmas lighting, also send photos of the sides and areas of your home you want lit. Text them to (629) 301-1813 or attach them to your quote email.

### What happens after I request a quote?

The quote form opens a pre-filled email in your email app. Press Send so it reaches Rapid Wash, and we'll follow up about your project. For Christmas lighting, we use your photos to create your free mockup, revise it until you're happy, and schedule installation once you approve the design.

### How can I contact Rapid Wash?

Call or text (629) 301-1813, or email rapidwashprosbros@gmail.com.

### Does Rapid Wash install Christmas lights?

Yes. Rapid Wash installs Christmas lights for homes in Middle Tennessee. You send photos of the areas you want lit, we create a free design mockup, you can request changes, and once you approve the design we schedule your job and install the lights.

### Is the Christmas lighting mockup free?

Yes. The design mockup is free, and you can request changes before anything is installed. Nothing goes up until you've approved the design.
